episodeTitle.en: Why PMs are suddenly valuable again | Tulsee Doshi (Head of Product, Gemini)
episodeTitle.zh: 为什么产品经理突然又变得有价值了？｜Gemini 产品负责人 Tulsee Doshi

guestBioOfficial.zh: Tulsee Doshi 在 Google 负责前沿 AI 模型的产品工作，范围包括 Gemini 及图像、视频和音乐模型。她常在研究团队和应用团队之间工作，把模型的能力边界变成可以讨论的产品决定。
guestBioOfficial.en: Tulsee leads product work on Google’s frontier AI models, including Gemini and models for images, video, and music. Her role connects model research with decisions about what people can actually use.

title.en: Why PMs are suddenly valuable again | Tulsee Doshi (Head of Product, Gemini)
title.zh: 为什么产品经理突然又变得有价值了？｜Gemini 产品负责人 Tulsee Doshi

summary.zh: 模型表现参差不齐时，产品经理要决定哪些体验已经值得做、哪些仍需等待。Tulsee 用多模态创作工具谈界面选择，用尚不完美的使用场景谈发布判断，也谈了她怎样管理动机各异的 PM。
summary.en: Tulsee explores product decisions at the uneven edge of model capability: which interfaces fit different media, which imperfect experiences deserve more investment, and what motivates the PMs who make those calls.

insights.title: 交互方式要配合用户正在创作的东西
insights.detail: 处理视频和音乐的 Flow，与处理笔记的工具，面对的是不同任务。Tulsee 把这些产品当成探索模型交互方式的不同实验。
insights.detailEn: Working with video or music suggests different interfaces from working with notes. Each product is an experiment in how to interact with a model.

insights.title: 把刚够用的场景单独拿出来判断
insights.detail: 有些结果今天还有缺陷，却已能看出下一步模型改进会带来什么体验。Tulsee 会明确这中间还差什么，再决定是否投入。
insights.detailEn: A barely usable case may point to an excellent future experience. Identify the specific model improvement needed before making the bet.

insights.title: 同一个 PM 岗位可以有不同的动力来源
insights.detail: 她举了团队里两位 PM 的例子：做相似的工作，愿意每天投入的原因却不同。管理者需要分别弄清他们在哪种任务上最能成长。
insights.detailEn: Two PMs on her team derive value from very different parts of the job. Understanding that difference changes how a leader supports them.

related.reason: 从另一家模型公司的产品负责人视角，看研究能力如何变成用户体验。
related.reasonEn: Another model company’s product leader on translating research advances into user experiences.
